footnote_text: Pursuant to the requirements of a certain transaction agreement by and among the Issuer and the Reporting Person, dated as of November 6, 2024 (the "Transaction Agreement"), as soon as reasonably practicable following the satisfaction of certain conditions set forth therein, the Reporting Person was required to distribute an aggregate of 3,000,000 shares of Acquiror Common Stock (as defined in the Transaction Agreement) out of the Share Consideration (as defined in the Transaction Agreement) previously received by the Reporting Person, to certain employees of the Reporting Person or its affiliates. The distribution was completed as of the date of this report.
